'''Ajolin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He advertised strongholds by [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] at [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
